title: Every tool call and hook event leaves a closed ops row the operator can read
goal: Every kb tool and shell call leaves one closed ops row of its tool, command class, agent group, duration and size; permission requests and denials, compactions and API-error turn ends leave closed rows; a hand-written python3 call is classed by purpose; an interrupted call is counted per item in the work sidecar; the weekly digest prints an ops block; kblog.py propose has run over every ops row for the operator to confirm; Claude Code's OpenTelemetry events reach a local file through a standard-library receiver and join the transcript; and intake files a draft for a command class or tool group repeated past its threshold.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
